planets.name: EPIC 211822797 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of EPIC 211822797 with a 21.2-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: EPIC 211822797 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around EPIC 211822797. Its orbit and size follow Castro-González et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
